title.zh: 主动出行（骑乘可登记个人代步工具——生效日期）命令 2019
title.en: Active Mobility (Riding of Registrable Personal Mobility Devices — Start Date) Order 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Active Mobility (Riding of Registrable Personal Mobility Devices — Start Date) Order 2019.

2. The specified date for the purposes of section 28B of the Act is 1 July 2019, in relation to the type of registrable personal mobility device prescribed in the Active Mobility (Registrable Personal Mobility Devices) Order 2019 (G.N. No. S 15/2019).
